snippet_primary: "If you're considering Gumroad, read the reviews here first. My experience matches what many creators report: Gumroad keeps your money if your balance is under $10 and refuses any manual payout — even when you decide to close your account. It doesn't matter that the money is yours, earned legitimately. Their answer is simply 'we can't do anything,' which leaves creators stuck with small balances they can never retrieve. This isn't what a creator-first platform looks like. The lack of transparency, the inflexible policies, and the dismissive support responses speak for themselves. There are better, more respectful alternatives out there. I recommend avoiding this platform."
